title: Beautiful deluxe 2 bed/2 bath for up to 6 guests.
description:
Relax with the whole family/friends at this peaceful place to stay.

You’ll want for nothing as you adventure day and night in Music City. This warm, friendly resort is close to Nashville’s best music, liquor, and historical landmarks. One mile from the Grand Ole, it provides a great base to explore all the middle Tennessee has to offer: The Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum and the Nashville Zoo, Plus, take a scenic drive out to the Jack Daniel’s Distillery or restaurants of Green Hills
